TECH TREE NOTES (resolved): Bronze Working card was partially off-screen at right edge. Its portrait icon (gold armor helmet) is at approx x=0.954, y=0.794. Hovering triggered tooltip but clicking did NOT select it directly. Selection was eventually achieved through a sequence of clicks including a white popup confirmation box that appeared at x~0.785-0.970, y~0.280-0.580 showing Bronze Working unlock icons (Barracks, Encampment, etc.). After closing Tech Tree with two Escape presses, World Tracker confirmed Bronze Working as active research.

CITY PRODUCTION — STUCK (critical active goal): City queue empty. Extensive failed attempts to open production panel:
- City banner left-clicks at y=0.307-0.308 WRONG — these coordinates were empty map space ABOVE the banner.
- CONFIRMED: City banner 'TENOCHTITLAN' is at y≈0.432 (not y=0.307). Circular spinning arrow (empty production) at right end of banner at x≈0.756, y≈0.432.
- Clicks at x=0.645-0.760, y=0.432 have also failed or been rejected as stale.
- City tile center at x≈0.638, y≈0.370 — clicking this did not select city or open production.
- Spinning circular arrow below banner (unit icon for empty production queue) attempted at x=0.544, y=0.456 — rejected stale.
- Red notification circle at x≈0.960, y≈0.462 — clicked, no effect.
- White popup box appeared twice at x≈0.800-0.910, y≈0.185-0.405 with gold coin icon (~x=0.829,y=0.333) and green circle icon (~x=0.829,y=0.357) at bottom-left. Clicking inside popup at x=0.783,y=0.24 and x=0.858,y=0.28 did not open production panel — popup disappeared.
- 'B' key shortcut attempted — rejected as stale.
- Right-click on city banner at x=0.645,y=0.308 — rejected as stale.
- NEXT TURN triggered at turn 44→45 hoping for auto-production prompt — no prompt appeared.
- Many actions rejected as stale_observation indicating game was in loading/transition state.
- Green light beam appeared at x≈0.515, y≈0.065-0.280 (possible great person or barbarian camp spawn — unresolved).
- Two teal/cyan shields visible NE at x≈0.829,y≈0.313 — may be a city-state or second civilization (unresolved).

UNIT STATUS: Eagle Warrior (cyan dragon shield, '13' label) north of city at x≈0.467, y≈0.265-0.270. No unit needs orders indicator visible currently. Trader built (useless without Market/Harbor). 1 Builder captured by Barbarians (turn 43). Second Builder status unknown — may not exist.

BARBARIAN THREAT: MASSIVE and persistent NE. Large red X sword shield at x≈0.838-0.839, y≈0.264-0.265 (upgraded unit — swordsman-level). Red pin/marker shield at x≈0.879, y≈0.370. Soldiers at x≈0.855-0.910, y≈0.370-0.430. Red swirling storm effect in upper map area indicating barbarian outpost. Bronze Working boost requires killing 3 barbarians.

CONFIRMED CONTROLS:
- NEXT TURN rectangular button: x=0.935, y=0.729 (also seen at y=0.524, y=0.818 — position varies)
- NEXT TURN circular arrow: x=0.936, y=0.885 (sometimes rejected stale)
- Escape: closes filter dropdown first, then closes Tech Tree
- Tech globe: x=0.023, y=0.05 opens Tech Tree
- Civics book: x=0.065, y=0.05 (DO NOT confuse with globe)
- CHOOSE PRODUCTION gear: x=0.934, y=0.882 (opens production panel when visible)
- CHOOSE RESEARCH button: x=0.885, y=0.729 opens Tech Tree directly
- Research Completed popup X: x=0.610, y=0.106
- Unit sleep/skip moon icon: x≈0.846-0.897, y≈0.535-0.743 (varies)
- Wait 2s for PLEASE WAIT loading states
- Many actions rejected as stale_observation when game is loading/transitioning

PRODUCTION PANEL layout (when it opens via gear x=0.934,y=0.882): Wonders header (Stonehenge 19t), Units: Settler 9t, Builder 7t, Trader 5t, Scout 4t, Slinger 3t, Eagle Warrior 5t at bottom. Eagle Warrior row y-position uncertain — clicking y=0.671 selected Builder on map; y=0.935 dismissed panel. Hover rows to identify by tooltip before clicking.

POLICIES: Agoge (+50% melee/ranged prod) + Urban Planning (+1 prod).

ACTIVE GOALS (priority order):
1) Queue Eagle Warrior production — STUCK, city production panel cannot be opened reliably
2) Address massive barbarian force NE (kill 3 for Bronze Working boost)
3) Fix Amenities=-1
4) Monitor Early Empire civic (6t, grow to pop 6)
5) Find/assign remaining Builder

- Best method to open production panel (all banner/tile click approaches failed or stale)
- Whether CHOOSE PRODUCTION gear at x=0.934,y=0.882 appears only when city is selected via correct method

- Second Builder existence
- Exact Eagle Warrior row y in production panel
